# AI-augmented project

> How a person, a language model and a machine are set up and run one project together: what the machine checks, what the model is given and may do, what stays the person's, and the loop between the three. A first-pass review of 39 sources ends on the baseline B1; the design document is written and proposed, awaiting approval.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [AI-augmented project](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/evidence/README.md): the first-pass review, its five steps and its bibliography
- [Human-AI teaming](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/evidence/human-ai-teaming/README.md): 39 sources, the four questions answered, the baseline B1
- [Design document](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/design/one-project.md): five decisions on who decides, the start of a session, memory, the measure and the extension's interface
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-project/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
